{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-gauge turtleneck sweater: slim fit, hip length, ivory (#F2EBDD), merino wool

Straight-leg trousers: high waist, full length to the top of the boot, charcoal (#3A3D42), wool-blend flannel

Tailored blazer: single-breasted, hip length, heathered taupe-brown (#6B645C), textured wool tweed

Overcoat: straight cut, single-breasted, mid-calf length, deep navy (#1F2A44), wool-cashmere blend

Ankle boots: low block heel, round toe, black (#1C1C1C), water-resistant leather with a grippy rubber lug sole

Socks: crew length, charcoal (#3A3D42), merino-blend knit

Scarf: oversized, folded once at the neck, burgundy (#6D2332), soft lambswool

Gloves: wrist length, black (#1C1C1C), leather with a cashmere lining

Tote bag: structured, closed top, black (#1C1C1C), smooth leather that wipes clean

Why this outfit works: it stays within neat business dress with a refined knit, trousers, a textured jacket and ankle boots, so it looks professional for the meeting. The layers of merino, tweed and a wool-cashmere coat keep you warm during a 20-minute walk in frost and snow. The water-resistant boots with a lug sole give you grip on snow and are easy to wipe clean of road salt, and the full-length trousers keep the hems away from slush. The ivory, charcoal and navy palette is calm and cohesive, and the burgundy scarf adds a single point of color."}
